addendum_content_raw:
In Part VII - Investments and Trusts - | have listed, for the first time, various life insurunce policies that were purchased years ago (in the 1980s) by me and my

spouse, To be clear, while these policies have an investment component, there is no option to, and indeed 1 did not, select any funds for which to invest the

premiums, Rather, these policies are akin to whole life insurance policies, but with the option to build cash value. Additionally, although my spouse and | have

redeemed these policies in 2015, 1 did not report them on my prior financial disclosures because was not aware that these policies were subject to be disclosed.

In fact, 1 was under the mistaken impression that all life insurance policies are treated as "term" life insurance, which is not reportable. As such, | have placed an

X after each of the policies on Column A so as to introduce them for the first time in this report.
